cells.gaps: No count or share of primary clinics entering their own reports is held: the newest clinics fact (ZWE-028, 2022) has facilities on paper, keyed at the district. ZWE-022 (2025) disagrees on where data is digitised, giving facility-level flow into DHIS2, but for Impilo facilities only and without saying how the rest report. No plan is current at the as-at (the 2021-2025 strategy has ended) and nothing is dated inside the last twelve months.
cells.note: All four tiers report into the ministry's DHIS2 from paper keyed at the district, which is the whole of rung 3. Rung 4 needs more than half of primary clinics entering their own reports on a figure with a denominator, and none is held.

cells.gaps: No fact says an Impilo record can be retrieved at another facility, so `shared` is not held. The counts are of facilities where Impilo is deployed or implemented, all facility types, not of primary clinics entering records, and they disagree: 1,254 of a planned 1,900 at August 2025 (ZWE-010) against over 700 in an undated abstract carried at 2025 (ZWE-020); the 71.9% fully functional is one province. No plan is current at the as-at (both 2021-2025 strategies have ended) and no dated event falls in the last twelve months.
cells.note: Impilo runs at the point of care in clinics and hospitals across all ten provinces, which meets rung 3. Rung 4 needs the record shared on a unique identifier and retrievable elsewhere, and more than half of primary clinics entering, and neither is established.
